materials.function: Outer door skin directly behind woofer; high-loss local vibration damping / panel stiffening
materials.gate: Heavy high-loss automotive CLD around 4.2 mm; about 6 kg/m2; published MLF >=0.45 around 10 C; strong metal adhesion and automotive temperature suitability. Generic foam/roof/bitumen sheet is not equivalent.

materials.function: Outer + inner door metal / carrier; general resonance control
materials.gate: Butyl/aluminium automotive CLD around 2.0-2.5 mm; baseline foil 100 um; baseline areal mass 3.2-4.7 kg/m2; baseline MLF 0.33; durable self-adhesive automotive construction. Prefer published MLF and foil thickness.

materials.function: Outer door skin acoustic absorption/decoupling after CLD; wet-zone capable
materials.gate: Around 10 mm self-adhesive automotive absorber/decoupler; moisture/wet-zone suitable; water resistant/non-hygroscopic or protected against moisture; stable adhesive; useful mid/high frequency absorption. Thickness alone is insufficient.

materials.function: Second layer over CLD on inner door/carrier; moisture-exposed door cavity
materials.current_size: 470 x 375 mm official; Bünde listing may differ slightly
materials.gate: About 5 mm multilayer non-hygroscopic/moisture-resistant foam plus dense barrier membrane; about 31 dB air-noise index or comparable published test data; high-adhesion automotive adhesive. Plain 5 mm foam is not equivalent.

materials.function: Door trim/card treatment; combined absorption + heavy sound barrier
materials.gate: Heavy multilayer barrier + soft absorber; current product around 7 mm; >=4 kg/m2; about 31 dB air-noise index or comparable published test data; automotive adhesive and moisture suitability. Bünde kit text still shows an older 10 mm / 500x375 specification.

materials.function: Press CLD firmly onto metal and remove trapped air
materials.gate: Any suitable hard pressure roller that can apply uniform pressure without damaging foil is functionally acceptable.

alternatives.technical: 2.2 mm; 100 um aluminium; MLF 0.36; 3.07 kg/m2; automotive butyl CLD
alternatives.reason: Closest documented functional alternative. Same CLD function, near-identical thickness/foil and published MLF exceeds Black Gold baseline 0.33. Smaller sheets require more seams.

alternatives.technical: 2.5 mm; aluminium + butyl; about 4.5 kg/m2; self-adhesive; no bitumen
alternatives.reason: Good mass/thickness/value, but published MLF and foil thickness were not found. Verify those before declaring equivalence.

alternatives.technical: 2.0 mm; aluminium + butyl; about 3.5 kg/m2; self-adhesive; no bitumen
alternatives.reason: Very economical plausible CLD candidate, but thinner than baseline and lacks published MLF/foil data.

alternatives.technical: Indexed listing claims butyl rubber + aluminium foil; exact thickness, areal mass, foil thickness and MLF not verified
alternatives.reason: Search lead only. Require exact variant data, automotive temperature/adhesive specification and preferably published MLF before use.

alternatives.technical: 10 mm; 0.216 kg/m2; polymer-treated sound absorber; moisture protected; door/door-panel application
alternatives.reason: Strong documented functional absorber/decoupler alternative. Different construction from Accent, so this is functional rather than material-identical equivalence.

alternatives.package: 200 x 50 cm; listing includes 5/10 mm variants
alternatives.technical: Closed-cell foam listing; exact selected 10 mm variant and density/absorption/adhesive data not verified
alternatives.reason: Potential budget lead only. Verify actual 10 mm variant, closed-cell/water behavior, adhesive heat range, density and suitability inside a wet door cavity before purchase.
